_comment: Local-dev launcher read by `anna-app dev` / `anna-app executa dev`: runs `go run .` in this directory (first launch compiles and caches). tool_id follows the dev placeholder pattern tool-test-<slug>-12345678, where <slug> == describe().name == manifest required_executas 'bundled:<slug>'. Published builds ship as the binary archives made by scripts/package_executa.py.
